name: Dairow Vin
backstory:
Dairow and his husband fled Elturel for a better life. At some point they separated, Dairow taking work with the Guild, and his husband travelling with a group of refugees.

After losing contact with his husband, Dairow contacted guildmaster Nine-Fingers Keene to try and find information on his whereabouts. The Guild were able to track the latest refugees he was travelling with, but after crossing paths with the Absolute's forces, the entire group went missing without a trace.

Grieving the loss and probable death of his husband, Dairow consumed a large quantity of , falling into an impenetrable slumber in the city sewers.

Dairow's husband is speculated to be the brother of the dead refugee Garrett, whose corpse can be found by the cliffside in Rivington. Information supporting this assertion can be learned by using Dairow through which it is revealed that he fled from the Absolute's army with his brother. Additional evidence includes the note on Dairow Vin's body, which shows his husband was also a refugee. Also on the refugee's body is the which, when combined with the held by Ferg Drogher, creates a . If Garrett is asked about the ring using Speak with Dead, he answers that the ring belonged to his brother - who died on the road. Finally, if pickpocketing or killing Dairow Vin, a similar tarnished ring can be found. All of these details lend credence to the theory that Garrett’s brother was Dairow’s husband, and the Tarnished Rings were their wedding bands.
